summary: The AI video generation landscape in 2025-2026 is highly competitive, with Google's Veo 3.1 widely regarded as the best all-around model while Runway, Kling, Pika, and Luma remain popular for their distinct strengths in camera control, cost-effective iteration, and natural motion. Avatar-focused tools like Synthesia and HeyGen dominate the enterprise and corporate-communications niche, serving a large and sticky user base distinct from cinematic generators. Note that OpenAI's Sora is excluded here per the discontinuation requirement, and the market continues to fragment as users increasingly adopt multiple models rather than locking into one.

tools.name: Google Veo 3.1
tools.pricing_paid: Available via Google AI Pro/Ultra plans (approx. $19.99-$249.99/month) and Gemini; also through Vertex AI pay-as-you-go
tools.max_length: ~8 seconds per clip (extendable via scene stitching)
strengths: Best overall quality and prompt adherence
tools.best_for: All-around high-quality video generation with synced audio

tools.name: Runway Gen-3 / Gen-4
strengths: Industry-leading camera control and motion brush
tools.best_for: Professional filmmakers and creatives needing precise camera and motion control

tools.name: Kling AI
tools.pricing_paid: Standard from ~$6.99/month, Pro and Premier tiers up to ~$65/month
tools.max_length: Up to ~2 minutes with extensions (10s base clips)
tools.best_for: Cost-effective, high-quality video iteration at scale

tools.name: Pika
tools.best_for: Casual creators and social media content with creative effects

tools.name: Luma Dream Machine
tools.best_for: Natural-looking motion and smooth cinematic clips

tools.name: Synthesia
tools.best_for: Corporate training, L&D, and professional avatar presenter videos

tools.name: HeyGen
tools.best_for: Marketing videos, personalized avatars, and multilingual video translation

tools.name: Hailuo AI (MiniMax)
tools.pricing_paid: Standard from ~$9.99/month, Pro and Unlimited tiers up to ~$94.99/month
tools.best_for: Affordable cinematic text-to-video with strong prompt following

tools.name: Adobe Firefly Video
tools.pricing_paid: Included with Creative Cloud / Firefly plans from ~$9.99/month (Standard) to ~$29.99/month (Pro)
tools.best_for: Commercial/enterprise creators needing copyright-safe generation in Adobe workflows

tools.name: Seedance (Doubao)
tools.pricing_paid: Available via BytePlus/Volcano Engine API pay-as-you-go pricing
tools.best_for: High-quality multi-shot generation via API for developers and businesses

tools.name: Haiper AI
tools.best_for: Hobbyists and creators experimenting with free/low-cost video generation
